verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an operating system or desktop distribution like Omarchy, so the axis applies. The only time-based feature in the evidence is a one-off countdown reminder (`omarchy reminder 7 'Tea ready'`), which is not a recurring schedule. Automatic snapshots run on each update, which is an event trigger rather than a user-defined recurring job, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
